alternatives_considered: equivalence - This could capture the correspondence between local and global structures, but it misses the essential role of cohomological functors as the mediating machinery that makes the local-to-global principle work
decisions.reasoning: This convergence is fundamentally about how local data determines global properties through cohomological functors, which is best captured by categorical machinery. The claim involves multiple cohomology theories (sheaf cohomology, étale cohomology) and their relationship to global invariants, suggesting the need for functorial relationships and possibly derived categories.

Category theory provides the framework for sheaf cohomology and derived functors that connect local-to-global principles. Algebraic structures are essential for the local algebraic data (rings, modules) and topology provides the geometric substrate through schemes and their cohomology theories.

decisions.choice: We construct categories of local algebraic data (étale neighborhoods) and show that cohomological invariants (both coherent and étale) form sheaves on these categories. Global cohomology is recovered as global sections of these sheaves, establishing that local data determines these global invariants. The arithmetic content comes from Galois actions on étale cohomology.
